proposed_experiment: Run massive MC simulations with multi-spin coding (C-accelerated) for n up to 10^5-10^6. Fit KPZ scaling ansatz γ_n = γ₂ + c₁·n^{-1/3} + c₂·n^{-2/3} to obtain high-precision γ₂ estimate. Test if estimate matches PSLQ integer relation detection against known constants.

Implement frog dynamics for all binary periodic words of period ≤12. Compute γ(W) for each. Find the word W* maximizing γ(W). If γ(W*) > 0.792666, this provides a new certified lower bound. Compare frog dynamics results with direct MC simulation of LCS(W^(n), R_n).

Formulate the LCS upper bound as an optimal transport problem with monotonicity constraints. Solve the LP relaxation using Sinkhorn-type iterations. Compare resulting upper bound with Lueker's 0.826280.

Implement Bernoulli matching (mean-field) approximation for LCS. Compute γ_BM and compare with true γ₂. Develop systematic corrections via cluster expansion of correlations. Measure how many correction terms are needed to approach known bounds.

Measure Var[LCS(n,n)] for n = 100 to 10^5. Fit power law Var ~ n^{2χ} to determine the fluctuation exponent χ. Test KPZ prediction χ = 1/3 vs diffusive χ = 1/2. Use the result to determine optimal finite-size scaling ansatz.
